admin-console.title: Administration

descriptions.overview: A focused workspace for teacher applications and the daily operation of Tilawa.
descriptions.teachers: Review applications and manage which teachers can appear on the website.
descriptions.students: The student directory and the information needed for learning and support.
descriptions.lessons: Follow lesson schedules and status. Lesson acceptance stays with the teacher.
descriptions.subscriptions: Website packages, teacher offers and student lesson credits in one place.
descriptions.audit: A clear record of administrative decisions and settings changes.
descriptions.settings: Manage teacher registration and prepare the administration security settings.
descriptions.finance: Read-only payment records, teacher balances and filtered USD reports.

admin-console.review-queue-hint: Review each teacher’s profile and documents before deciding.

scope.students: This directory will show the student’s name, country and account status. Private Quran notes and personal conversations are outside its scope.
scope.lessons: The schedule will show the two participants, subject, date and lesson status, without administrator approval of bookings.
scope.subscriptions: Website and teacher subscriptions will be separated, with actual remaining credits and renewal dates.

admin-console.security-pending: Mandatory administrator MFA and Cloudflare Access are the next security phase; this interface does not claim that they are active.
